result.summary: Found 1 major content issue: an unresolved localization placeholder is displayed as a section title, with all other elements appearing properly rendered and functional.

issues.description: The section title shows the unresolved localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable, intended title (such as 'Popular near you' or equivalent).
issues.suggestion: Replace the placeholder key with the correct localized, human-readable title text for this section, or fix the localization system to render the proper user-facing string instead of the raw key.
